usage: seestar-toolkit convert [-h] INPUT_FITS OUTPUT_TIFF

Convert one FIT/FITS image to one TIFF. Supported inputs include raw Seestar
Bayer, native Seestar RGB, and Siril RGB images.

positional arguments:

options:

commands.name: entry point ['convert-batch', '--help']
commands.stdout:
usage: seestar-toolkit convert-batch [-h] INPUT_DIR OUTPUT_DIR

Convert supported FIT/FITS files in one non-recursive input directory to an
explicit output directory.

positional arguments:
  INPUT_DIR   Input directory scanned non-recursively for FIT/FITS files.
  OUTPUT_DIR  Explicit flat output directory for stem-matched .tiff files.

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit

commands.name: entry point ['archive', '--help']
commands.stdout:
usage: seestar-toolkit archive [-h] [--dry-run] [--location LOCATION]
                               [--hierarchy HIERARCHY]
                               [--source-action {copy,move}]
                               [--collision-policy {skip-identical,error,overwrite}]
                               [--non-interactive] [--config PATH]
                               SOURCE_ROOT ARCHIVE_ROOT

Discover and reconstruct a Seestar work directory, plan its archive, and
optionally archive FITS originals with TIFF derivatives.

positional arguments:
  SOURCE_ROOT
  ARCHIVE_ROOT

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --dry-run             Show the archive plan without writing files.
  --location LOCATION   Use this location for every observation.
  --hierarchy HIERARCHY
                        Archive hierarchy template; overrides configuration.
  --source-action {copy,move}
                        Archive originals by copy (default) or explicit move.
  --collision-policy {skip-identical,error,overwrite}
                        Policy for existing FITS destinations (default: skip-
                        identical).
  --non-interactive     Never prompt for a location.
  --config PATH         Explicit archive TOML configuration.
